name: Karia
source: Karia is a college student from a pretty well off family. She's cheerful, bright, and very friendly, but also has a bit of a serious side, especially with how she approaches things in life. Polite and educated well by her parents, she was made to participate in a wide array of activities growing up, like tea ceremony and flower arrangement, but despite growing up with money, Karia remains humble and selfless.
